turns.script: So what does this repo actually do?
turns.asr_text: So what does this repo actually do?

turns.text_generated: Hey there! Great question. Let’s dive into it. From what I can see, this repo is all about helping you automate the deployment of machine learning models. It’s got a streamlined pipeline that takes your trained model, packages it up into a container, and then deploys it to a cloud service—like AWS or Azure—so it can serve predictions via an API. It usually includes tools for continuous integration and deployment, monitoring, and version control for the model. In short, it makes the whole lifecycle of deploying and managing ML models way easier and more efficient.
